design_brief.subject: Hosted social event balance + outdoor-social routing
design_brief.job: Codify RCA and a priority call stack for event goals, critical needs, homework, and indoor venue routing so balancing is not chat-only
design_brief.forbidden_chrome: No event dashboard UI; contracts + evaluators only

local_observed.observation: Every social interaction routed Sims onto outdoor sidewalk under umbrella despite indoor negative space, rain, and incomplete event goals; Fun/Energy pressuring while party timer advances

hypotheses.claim: Event/venue greeting or social routing defaults to outdoor meetup / lot edge points
hypotheses.falsifier: Indoor free social tiles exist AND interactions still always start outdoors

hypotheses.claim: Indoor chairs/stand spots occupied so autonomy picks outdoor free tiles
hypotheses.falsifier: Observed free indoor floor/stand space with still-outdoor routing

hypotheses.claim: Rain + umbrella social affordance pulls pairs outside
hypotheses.falsifier: Same outdoor default on clear weather

hypotheses.claim: Sidewalk counts as valid venue lot social space, so autonomy treats it as fine
hypotheses.falsifier: Autonomy prefers marked indoor social objects when free

hypotheses.claim: Indoor open floor is not tagged as social routing tiles
hypotheses.falsifier: Go Here / indoor Sim click succeeds without outdoor prefix

hypotheses.claim: Angry/scared moodlets bias outdoor conversation routing
Host/player social clicks resolve to Sims already outdoors
Venue footprint too small / object density forces outdoor
hypotheses.falsifier: Larger venue or cleared density removes outdoor default

rca.host_disposition: Treat repeated outdoor social prefix during indoor event with free indoor capacity as BAD_BEHAVIOR / OPTIMIZE routing — cancel outdoor walk, retarget indoor Sim or Go Here indoors. Do not claim EA autonomy rewrite until patch-specific tuning proof.

SURVIVAL_NEEDS_CRITICAL.note: Energy red during party still outranks greet spam; prefer venue toilet/bed/food if present else MAP_TRAVEL home

EVENT_GOAL_PROGRESS.note: Timer-bound goals outrank homework and non-event fluff while event is active

HOMEWORK_HOLD_OR_SCHEDULE.note: Homework is durable obligation but not mid-party outdoor thrash

open_items.summary: Confirm whether larger venue / indoor social objects change outdoor default; may need Studio object/routing evidence later
